# Minutes of the institute committee, 9 June 2025

Present: Aiko Tanaka (chair), Maria Lopez (Finance Office), J. Pike, Samuel Osei.

1. Aldmoor overrun. J. Pike explained the equipment overrun of the Aldmoor peat project: a second corer had to be bought after the first one jammed in December. The committee accepted the explanation.

2. Flume. Samuel Osei measured the flume pump vibration at 60 litres per second: 2.3 mm/s, below the 4.5 mm/s limit. Experiments above 60 litres per second may now start.

3. Travel. Maria Lopez reported that 60 percent of the 2025 travel budget has been spent.

Aiko Tanaka closed the meeting at 15:55.
